style_rules: Use a clean 2D illustrated explainer style.
Use an editorial cartoon visual language.
Use minimal shading and a professional YouTube explainer finish.
Build a concrete everyday situation with one dominant readable action.
Keep FIN integrated into the situation instead of presenting the character as a mascot.
Use a simple supportive environment and no more than three narratively essential props.
Keep the frame immediately readable in 16:9 with restrained editorial lighting.
negative_rules: No character redesign or deviation from FIN_V1.
No promotional pose, mascot showcase or decorative staging.
No infographic, abstract metaphor or symbolic composition.
No text, labels, captions, letters, numbers or watermarks inside the image.
No extra people, crowded background or unnecessary props.
purpose: Canonical qualitative reference profile for production-ready FIN situational illustrations; reference images guide visual language and never define reusable scene geometry.
